bagPolicy.summary: There are no size or material limits on bags, but security may search every bag at the entrance.
bagPolicy.quote: We do not have restrictions pertaining to size or material of bags.

parking.summary: There are several lots nearby, including one right across from the venue by Tired Hands. Some spots are metered and some lots are only open on certain nights, so read the signs. The parking garage on Cricket Ave is free after 6 p.m.
parking.quote: There are numerous lots in the immediate area, like right across the venue by Tired Hands.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Ardmore Music Hall. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The in-house kitchen serves food during all events, and four bars pour craft beer, cocktails, wine and non-alcoholic drinks. Outside food and drinks are not allowed, and cash payments carry no added fee.
concessions.quote: Yes, our in-house kitchen is open and serving food during all events.

accessibility.summary: Ardmore Music Hall is ADA compliant and has a few accessible seating options. Contact the venue before the show with any ADA requests at info@ardmoremusichall.com or 610-649-8389.
accessibility.quote: Yes! Ardmore Music Hall is ADA compliant and offers a few accessible seating options.

reEntry.summary: Ardmore Music Hall hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is open Monday, Wednesday and Friday from 12 to 5 p.m. and during events. All tickets are digital, but if you have trouble, the box office can print your ticket at will call on show night with a valid photo ID. Concerts are 21+ unless you're with a parent or legal guardian, and expired IDs are not accepted.
ticketPickup.quote: Our box office team can print tickets at will-call the night of the event.

gates.summary: Hold your phone near the scanner at the door, and expect a bag search at the entrance. Seated tickets guarantee a seat, but seats are unassigned and first come, first served.
gates.quote: We offer a seated ticket type for almost every event.
